- h1: keep unchanged; confidence=high; reason=Current price is within 2.57% of h1 anchor; matched examples show h1 rarely requires adjustment when spot is close to forecast.
- h5: negative adjustment; confidence=medium; magnitude=small; reason=Spot is below h5 anchor (-0.89%); matched examples consistently show downward corrections for medium horizons when spot lags forecast.
- h20: negative adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Spot is significantly below h20 anchor (-2.70%); all matched examples indicate strong downward pressure on long horizons when spot underperforms.
- h30: keep unchanged; confidence=low; reason=Spot is above h30 anchor (+4.30%); freezing prevents contradiction with the strong downward bias observed in shorter horizons.
